title: appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Incorrect arithmetic in explanatory note
description: Line 128 states 'yielding 1 + (926423932 % 7) = 2' but 926423932 mod 7 equals 0 (since 926423932 = 132346276 * 7 exactly), so the result would be 1, not 2. Either the hash value shown is wrong, or the arithmetic is wrong.
